description_en: Updates the enabled status of an address pool
description_zh: 根据传入参数修改地址池启用状态
kebab_example: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-address-pool-enable-status --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-pool-id pool-895280232254420000 --enable-status enable --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCloudGtmAddressPoolEnableStatus

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese

en-US (default): English
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

zh-CN：中文

en-US（默认值）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The client token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the address pool
parameters.help_zh: 地址池的ID，地址池的唯一识别码
parameters.name: address_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
The enabled status of the address pool:

enable: Enables the address pool. If the health check is normal, the address pool is included in DNS resolution.

disable: Disables the address pool. The address pool is not included in DNS resolution, regardless of its health check status
parameters.help_zh:
地址池的启用状态：
enable：启用，当前地址池在健康检查正常的情况下可参与解析。
disable： 禁用，当前地址池不管健康检查是否正常，均不可参与解析
parameters.name: enable_status

AddressPoolId.description_en: The unique ID of the address pool
AddressPoolId.description_zh: 地址池的ID，地址池的唯一识别码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
本次修改操作是否成功：

true：操作成功

false：操作失败
